atoms.b: Metamorphic rocks are formed when other ((++rocks plastics)) are affected by extreme conditions.
Unlike igneous rocks, metamorphic rocks do not ((++melt freeze)) when affected by extreme heat.
Metamorphic rocks form when other rocks are affected by extreme ((++heat cold)) and ((++pressure stretching)).
Slate is formed from ((++shale limestone)), marble is formed from ((++limestone granite)) and gneiss is formed from ((++granite shale)).
The outside layer of the Earth is called the ((++crust flake)).
This layer is made up of ((++tectonic_plates trees)).
The movements of tectonic plates change the ((++landscape animal_population)) of the Earth.
